planned_arguments.prompt:
Make a LOCAL OBJECT EDIT to this own poster. Return exactly ONE finished flat opaque16:9 landscape poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Change only the rubber-block printing mechanism at the middle-left of the common yellow page. Actual observed problem: the current rectangular slab has tan wood-like beveled sides and its lower-right edge floats beside the matching paper motif. Replace this object with a visibly pliable thick DARK TEAL RUBBER slab: a continuous teal-gray rubber body, softly rounded corners, compressed edge, NO tan wooden sides or mount. Preserve the existing asymmetric leaf and two curved bars as nonletter positive relief on the inked underside; show a narrow clean dark sidewall. The left person's continuous arm/hand still grips the upper outer edge. Move and pivot the rubber slab toward the fresh motif until its lower-right lip actually MEETS the paper at the left edge of the transferred leaf. Bend that soft lower-right lip slightly as it peels upward. A short dark contact/release seam and tiny consistent local shadow identify the exact point where rubber leaves paper. Keep the complete fresh paper impression visible to the right of the peeled lip and the relief underside exposed toward the viewer. Match leaf/bar outline and mirror-transfer relationship, visibly the SAME printing on the SAME sheet read by the adults. Clear hand ownership, fingers only on outer upper edge, wrist continues to existing left forearm. Avoid any overlap with all text. Keep the current fresh motif approximately in its page location, reduce only its height modestly toward a compact wide leaf-plus-two-bars footprint.

Protect the current entire composition: two huge inward-facing coral/orange ADULT profiles with eyes/noses/mouths, plum side fields, one speaking mouth, complete frontal warm-yellow sheet with visible top/bottom, all supporting margin grips, existing flat carved contours and restrained grain. Preserve every one of the existing eleven printed lines exactly ONCE with identical Korean/English spelling, numbers, word spaces and punctuation, current readable type sizes and horizontal baselines. Do not re-typeset or move title, identity, activity, attendance or participation rows. Do not add any word, glyph, logo, watermark, QR, pseudo-print or annotation. Keep a friendly adult cultural tone, not childish. No tape, scraps, 3D, mockup, comparison panel, extra scene or second poster. The repair is finished only when the printed paper and the real soft-rubber peel contact are visibly linked, while the shared reading and all clear copy remain protected.
